Total token supply, fully minted to a fixed address in the constructor.
Guard/blacklist address used to block transfers and mutated implicitly inside transferFrom.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization and balance accounting.
Deployer-only constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending newOwner address.
Function that lets newOwner complete the ownership handover.
Constructor that initialises metadata and mints the whole supply to a hard-coded address.
onlyOwner function that updates the newun guard address.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].

Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.

Payable fallback in TokenBEP20 that unconditionally reverts.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, deriving the privileged role from an untrusted caller.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership reads the owner state variable to authorize the call.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership performs the privileged state write of newOwner.
_newOwner parameter is stored verbatim into the newOwner state variable without validation.
_newOwner is the declared parameter consumed by transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership uses the newOwner state variable as the authorization source.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before committing the handover.
acceptOwnership executes the privileged writes owner = newOwner and newOwner = address(0).
The value of newOwner becomes the new owner via the commit write.
transfernewun is guarded by onlyOwner which reads owner.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender before newun can be changed.
transfernewun writes the newun guard address that gates all transfers.
_newun parameter flows into the newun state variable, controlling which recipients are blocked.
TokenBEP20 constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply.
TokenBEP20 constructor mints the entire supply into balances at a hard-coded address.
transfer reads newun inside the require(to != newun) guard.
transfer reverts when the recipient equals newun, gating who can receive tokens.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the untrusted caller address.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
to parameter is used as the transfer recipient and in the newun guard.
tokens parameter is used as the transfer amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in the allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value in approve.
from parameter is the account debited by transferFrom.
to parameter is the account credited by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
The first transferFrom silently executes the privileged newun assignment when newun is unset.
The caller-supplied to parameter becomes the newun guard address through the implicit assignment.
The implicit assignment writes the newun state variable without an owner check.
transferFrom enforces require(to != newun) for subsequent calls once newun is set.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
The spender parameter is cast directly to ApproveAndCallFallBack and called, letting the caller choose the callee.
tokens parameter is forwarded to receiveApproval.
Caller-supplied data bytes are forwarded unchanged to receiveApproval.
approveAndCall updates allowance state and then performs an external call to an attacker-controlled address.
receiveApproval executes in the caller's context and can re-enter approveAndCall/approve before the external call returns.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approveAndCall.
clearCNDAO is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier that reads owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner before the balance drain is executed.
clearCNDAO performs an external ETH transfer of the entire contract balance to the caller.
Local _owner holds the recipient address used by the transfer.
Local _owner is initialised from the untrusted msg.sender.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the first index of allowed in allowance.
spender parameter is the second index of allowed in allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter has no independent semantics; it only feeds the newOwner state write, so it is folded into the set_newOwner unsafe operation.
The _newun parameter exists solely to set the newun guard and should be merged into the set_newun unsafe operation.
The to parameter is a local view of transfer's recipient argument used for the newun guard and the balance credit.
The tokens parameter is a local view of the transfer amount used by the balance arithmetic.
The from parameter is a local view of the debited account inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is the value written into newun by the implicit assignment, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The tokens parameter is a local view of the transferFrom amount used by the balance and allowance arithmetic.
The spender parameter is the callee address of the external receiveApproval call and merges into that unsafe operation.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The data parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The local _owner is purely the recipient of the balance transfer and merges into the eth_transfer_drain unsafe operation.
The spender parameter is a local index into allowed for the approve function.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
The tokenOwner parameter is a local index used only to read the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter is a local index used only to read the allowed mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter is a local index used only to read the balances mapping.
